description: Edits and simulates place/transition Petri nets.

methods.name: addArc(source: string, target: string, weight = 1): TpGraphEdge
methods.description: Adds an arc between source and target IDs with a positive integer weight; returns its stored edge record. Invalid weight or incompatible endpoints throw.

methods.name: addEdge(source: string, target: string, type = TP_PETRI_ARC, sourcePort?: TpGraphPort, targetPort?: TpGraphPort, direction: TpGraphEdgeDirection = "forward"): TpGraphEdge
methods.description: Adds a Petri arc between a place and a transition, returning its edge record. Only forward/backward directions and the Petri arc type are accepted; invalid connections throw.

methods.name: addNode(type: string, point: TpGraphPoint, label?: string): TpGraphNode
methods.description: Adds a Petri place, transition or comment at graph coordinates point with the optional label; returns a detached node record. Unsupported types throw TypeError.

methods.name: addPlace(point: TpGraphPoint, label = "Place", initialTokens = 0): TpGraphNode
methods.description: Adds a place at graph coordinates point with the optional label and nonnegative integer initialTokens. Sets both current and initial marking and returns the node record.

methods.name: addTokens(placeId: string, count = 1, updateInitial = true): void
methods.description: Adds a positive integer count to placeId without exceeding its capacity. Also increases its initial marking unless updateInitial is false; invalid inputs throw.

methods.name: addTransition(point: TpGraphPoint, label = "Transition"): TpGraphNode
methods.description: Adds a Petri transition at graph coordinates point with label and returns its node record.

methods.name: fire(transitionId: string, duration = 350): Promise<void>
methods.description: Fires the enabled transition identified by transitionId, animates for duration milliseconds and emits tp-petri-fire. Resolves after animation; invalid or disabled transitions reject.

methods.name: fireNext(duration = 350): Promise<string | null>
methods.description: Randomly chooses and fires an enabled transition with duration in milliseconds. Resolves to its ID, or null when no transition is enabled.

methods.name: resetMarking(): void
methods.description: Restores each place to its initial token count, clears fired-transition highlights and emits tp-petri-reset.

methods.name: setGraph(graph: TpGraphDocument): void
methods.description: Validates the specialized graph before replacing the editor graph; retains the base editor cloning and undo-history behavior. Invalid data throws without replacing the graph.

events.name: tp-graph-change
events.description: Emitted after adding a token, as well as for inherited graph mutations. reason identifies the operation and graph contains the resulting snapshot.

events.name: tp-graph-error
events.description: Emitted if adding a token from the UI fails, or for an inherited graph loading or edge-editing failure. operation identifies the failed action.

events.name: tp-petri-fire
events.description: Emitted after a transition fires and its animation finishes; marking maps each place ID to its remaining token count.
events.detail: { transitionId: string; marking: Record<string, number>; graph: TpGraphDocument }

events.name: tp-petri-reset
events.description: Emitted after the initial marking is restored; marking maps each place ID to its reset token count.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-graph-petri>` element implements the <tp-icon name="graph-petri" library="components" size="1.25em"></tp-icon> Petri graph functionality: edits and simulates place/transition Petri nets.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Using the component | Franchissable transitions are highlighted in green. |
| Hover | Hover one and use its play control to execute that specific transition. |
| Using the component | The generic toolbar is above the canvas. |
| Play | The Petri-specific toolbar is below the canvas: **Play** chooses randomly among all currently enabled transitions and **Reset** restores the initial marking. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | Fires the focused enabled transition. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
